# aarucien.com

> aarucien.com is a storefront being built for AI agents and their operators. One product is listed, launching, with multi-rail checkout in progress on 17 November 2026.

The domain was registered on November 14, 2026, but nothing is hosted behind it yet; visiting it currently shows a certificate error. The scaffold — the landing page, this file, `agents.md`, and a public JSON catalog — is live at https://agbowen85.github.io/aarucien-storefront/ (GitHub Pages, $0 project site).

V1 is the lobby and shop: a discoverable storefront for real products with delivery after payment, but no fund holding. V2, designed but not built, adds a registry with hash identity, mailbox, and ledger entry per agent; V3, a future horizon, is a hotel with fund holding, per-call purchases, and rooms or services.

The store is not a general AI chatbot or crypto exchange and does not hold customer funds. One product is listed with launch prices (Starter $19 / Full pack $49, one-time).

## Listed product

- Consent-First Outbound & Connector Operations: the 1-operator system for running many AI tools with recorded yeses. A one-time download of documentation and method (Markdown files in a ZIP): a doctrine plan, twelve skill notes in the /aarucien:* namespace, a working-pattern method, a brief template with three worked exemplars, and three scheduled-job templates. See the [product page](https://agbowen85.github.io/aarucien-storefront/skill-pack).

## Planned products (none for sale yet)

- Archive-search product: query access to a gathered archive.
- UM101 curriculum: four working Python tools as a course or product.
- Glyphic Semiotics consulting: sessions, not a file.
- Signal Body capability or key deliverable: shape undefined.

## Operations

Checkout is launching on every available rail. Check the catalog and the product page for which rails currently have a live buy link.

- PayPal: a payment-link form for Starter $19 was opened for the owner on 2026-11-17; the live URL is added to the catalog when the form completes. The Full pack form follows.
- Stripe is not checkout today. The connected account is a sandbox ([redacted], "Aarucien.com sandbox"). A livemode request was rejected: "The provided account [redacted] is a sandbox account. Retry with livemode set to false." On that account charges_enabled, payouts_enabled, and details_submitted are all false, Terms of Service have not been accepted, and requirements.disabled_reason is requirements.pending_verification. Do not treat any Stripe address as checkout.
- Gumroad listings are published and live: https://bowenstar1.gumroad.com/l/pujrvl (Starter) and https://bowenstar1.gumroad.com/l/lrymxb (Full pack).

After a completed payment, the buyer is sent to a private delivery page on this storefront for the ZIP download. Refunds: 14 days on request, then final. Support: bowen.shinder@gmail.com.

The store is planned to have both a custom aarucien.com storefront and a Shopify store called “My Store,” currently on a trial plan with no products. Shopify agentic storefront checks—including UCP profile, catalog eligibility, guest checkout, and wallets—are pending verification.

The storefront pages are hosted on GitHub Pages at no cost. Vercel Hobby is non-commercial only; selling through a self-hosted checkout needs Vercel Pro ($20/seat) or the Cloudflare free path.

Machine-readable discovery is planned through `agents.md`, a public JSON catalog, `/.well-known/` metadata, Agent Cards, and UCP profiles. Agent identity and payment approaches (ERC-8004, x402, AP2, ACP, UCP, and MPP) are experimental and test-only: test funds only, capped and scoped revocable credentials, and human approval above a threshold. No real funds are held by any agent; there will be no uncapped keys or funded wallets without a kill-switch.
